name: InboxZero Lite - AI Email Classifier
description: AI classifies Gmail emails as urgent, important, info, or spam using OpenAI gpt-4o-mini. Lightweight single-workflow setup with Google Sheets logging.

inputs.system: Classify this email as: urgent, important, informational, or spam. Also write a 1-sentence summary. JSON: { "category": "...", "summary": "..." }

setupVars.label: inboxzero sheet id (was the n8n environment variable INBOXZERO_SHEET_ID)

source.n8nName: InboxZero Lite - Simple Email Classifier (Log Only)

blockers.detail: webhook trigger googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE needs webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId

setup: "Gmail: New Email": after import, register the googlesuper webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.
Setup value inboxzeroSheetId: inboxzero sheet id (was the n8n environment variable INBOXZERO_SHEET_ID). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: "Gmail: New Email" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_NEW_MESSAGE --account <connectedAccountId>`.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## InboxZero Lite - Classify Only

Simplest version: classify + log.
No auto-actions, no Slack, no drafts.

Perfect for trying InboxZero before
enabling auto-actions.
